contract.goal: Implement daysBetween(from, to) in src/calendar.mjs. Both arguments are calendar dates as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings. It returns the number of whole calendar days from `from` to `to` (negative if `to` is earlier), treating dates as pure calendar values so daylight-saving changes and the machine's timezone never matter. Leap years must be handled correctly.
acceptance: result is independent of the machine timezone
negative when to is before from
